description:

dependency from the business logic layer into the UI component layer. Fix the layer violation first.

  @moduledoc """
  A node in the session tree returned by SessionManager.get_tree/1.
  Mirrors SessionTreeNode in tmp/pi-mono/.../core/session-manager.ts:152-160.
  """

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
          entry: Entry.t(),
          children: [t()],
          label: String.t() | nil,
          label_timestamp: String.t() | nil

end
